nodes.label: Task K3 Report — defined-length body streams incrementally; emitValues/walkBodyTail exported; implicit-SQ promotion bug found+fixed (commits 4a66448+4f43f2a)
K3 staged fallback ladder (deflate buffered / undefined-length tail-fallback / native defined-length)
nodes.rationale: Binding design decision to keep each stage small: deflate keeps the K2 buffered body; an undefined-length element mid-body triggers a tail-fallback (await completeness, seedReadContext, walkBodyTail from the element's start offset) because no events for that element were emitted yet; everything else streams natively. consume() call sites were wired but gated dormant (releaseEnabled=false) so K4 could flip one switch. Top-level SQs buffered their subtree events for fallback atomicity — discard-and-restart on TailFallbackSignal.

nodes.label: Implicit-SQ promotion bug in buffered fromPart10 (UN→SQ via data-peek / el.items)
nodes.rationale: Fix-round testing exposed a real divergence: for dictionary-unknown implicit elements whose value starts with an item tag, the parser's internal isSequence peek populates el.items, but resolveVrInstance (dictionary-only) returned UN — so buffered fromPart10 emitted UN where the standard intends SQ. Both fromPart10 (using el.items) and fromPart10Stream (repeating the raw byte peek per readDicomElementImplicit) received the same promotion so the two paths agree. A related pre-existing gap remains ledgered: readFileLazy/decodeCore.resolveVrInstance lacks the data-peek for DEFINED-length unknown implicit elements.
